from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    freq=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill=freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def mode_frac(vals):
        c=Counter(vals); v,n=c.most_common(1)[0]; return v,n/len(vals)
    rstats=[mode_frac(row) for row in grid]
    cstats=[mode_frac([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]
    # Structural separator color is the strongest color that forms near-uniform rows and columns.
    candidates=set(v for v,f in rstats if f>=0.8)&set(v for v,f in cstats if f>=0.8)
    if not candidates:
        candidates=set(v for v,f in rstats if f>=0.8)
    linecolor=max(candidates,key=lambda v: sum(f for x,f in rstats if x==v)+sum(f for x,f in cstats if x==v))
    rs=[i for i,(v,f) in enumerate(rstats) if v==linecolor and f>=0.8]
    cs=[i for i,(v,f) in enumerate(cstats) if v==linecolor and f>=0.8]
    # Retain the regularly spaced separator coordinates.
    def regular(coords):
        if len(coords)<3:return coords
        diffs=[b-a for a,b in zip(coords,coords[1:])]
        d=Counter(diffs).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [x for x in coords if (x-coords[0])%d==0]
    rs,cs=regular(rs),regular(cs)
    nodes=[[grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]
    active=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(nodes) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (linecolor,fill)]
    if not active:return []
    r0=min(i for i,j in active); r1=max(i for i,j in active)
    c0=min(j for i,j in active); c1=max(j for i,j in active)
    out=[]
    for i in range(r0,r1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(c0,c1):
            vals=(nodes[i][j],nodes[i+1][j],nodes[i][j+1],nodes[i+1][j+1])
            row.append(vals[0] if vals[0] not in (linecolor,fill) and all(v==vals[0] for v in vals) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
print(transform(grid))

    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); total=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row); threshold=.7
    def mode_frac(vals):
        c=Counter(vals); v,n=c.most_common(1)[0]; return v,n/len(vals)

    candidates=set(v for v,f in rstats if f>=threshold)&set(v for v,f in cstats if f>=threshold)
    def score(coords):
        if len(coords)<3:return 0
        ds=[b-a for a,b in zip(coords,coords[1:])]; return Counter(ds).most_common(1)[0][1]/len(ds)
    def pos(v,stats):return [i for i,(x,f) in enumerate(stats) if x==v and f>=threshold]
    linecolor=max(candidates,key=lambda v:(min(score(pos(v,rstats)),score(pos(v,cstats))),len(pos(v,rstats))+len(pos(v,cstats))))
    fc=total.copy();fc.pop(linecolor,None);fill=fc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs=pos(linecolor,rstats);cs=pos(linecolor,cstats); nodes=[[grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]
